ambient_chatter.text: anyone else notice the rain has been following me since lunch?? the sky is clearly picking sides :D
my goose has declared it will only fly in fair weather from now on. respect its wishes :)
found a goat in {village} that looks exactly like a tax collector. ser, do not make eye contact :)
lag today is so bad my knight just walked into a tree and apologised to it. we are all suffering :(
reminder that the bridge at Lipnevo still hasnt said sorry. i am not over it. i will never be over it !!

ambient_brag.text: my army of {troop_count} marched into {fief} and the locals started humming my war song. they are fans now :)
counted my coins tonight: {gold} gold. the goose has been sitting on them to keep them warm, very dignified bird
{fief} is ours, {troop_count} strong, and i have named its fountain sir gurgles. do not question the naming process :D
tallied up {gold} gold this week. i am not saying i am rich but the pigeons bow when i walk past now xD
{troop_count} spears, one confused goose, and {fief} now flies my colours. history will call this a tremendous success !!

beat_by_player.text: {player} beat my {troop_count} men like they owed them money?? absolutely robbed. i demand a rematch and an apology from the field itself :(
well played {player}... my {troop_count} men are still arguing about whose fault it was. mostly mine :)
ha, {player}, you got me good there. the goose is already writing my defeat into a sketch. rematch when i stop limping :D
{player} took {troop_count} of my lads off the field and still said nice things about the sausages. legend !!
lucky roll {player}!! sir soggy boots would be proud of that sword work, grudgingly :P

beat_player.text: {player} got sent home with {troop_count} fewer friends and {gold} gold lighter. the bridge at Lipnevo laughed, i heard it
{player}, i took {gold} gold off your books and your {troop_count} men are now my new cleaning crew :D
hah, {player}!! that was {gold} gold worth of sad face you just pulled. the goose is taking notes on your retreat :)
{troop_count} of them ran off the field and {player} tried to pay me in apologies. i accept, but only in gold xD
good fight {player}!! you owe me {gold} gold and a rematch, in that order :)

player_fled_from_me.text: {player} saw my banner and suddenly remembered urgent business somewhere else. the cowards road is well travelled, i see :D
running away {player}? bold strategy. the goose says it will be waiting for you right here :)
{player} took one look at me and sprinted like the bridge at Lipnevo owed them money. respect for the speed tho !!
{player} fled so fast they left a boot behind. i have claimed it. sir soggy boots now has a cousin :D
no need to flee {player}, i only bite on tuesdays. today is thursday. i checked with the goose :)

player_win_streak.text: {player} has won so many fights the bards are running out of rhymes. i am rewriting the ballads in my favour xD
{player} keeps winning and the server is starting to sound like a tavern brawl. someone bring {player} a pie :)
{player}, that's a fine streak. it's almost as impressive as my ability to pretend i'm not jealous :P
ok {player} the streak is getting embarrassing for everyone else. i am proud to be the one who will end it eventually !!
{player} on a win streak and nobody has stopped them yet. i am cheering from the corner with a stick and a goose :D

peace_made.text: {my_faction} and {faction} shook hands, which means one of them is about to be sneaky. i have my eye on you, {faction} :)
peace between {my_faction} and {faction}?? the goose is furious, it had plans for those tents xD
{my_faction} signed peace with {faction} and the bridge at Lipnevo still refuses to comment. shameful !!
{faction} has made peace with {my_faction}. i shall allow it, as long as nobody touches the goose :D
{my_faction} and {faction} are friends now. the tavern cheered, the bards wept, and i wept into my soup :(

war_declared.text: {my_faction} declared war on {enemy_faction}!! sent the goose on reconnaissance already. it returned with a fish :D
war between {my_faction} and {enemy_faction}?? finally, the sort of drama this server deserves !!
{enemy_faction} has dared to start a war with {my_faction}. the tavern is taking bets, the goose is in charge of odds :)
{my_faction} against {enemy_faction}, a fight for the ages. i'm dusting off the sausage-themed war banner xD
blood, glory and a sudden need for more boots. {my_faction} vs {enemy_faction}, let's go !! :D

encounter_greeting.text: ah, {player}!! {persona} of {my_faction} here, and you are standing in the path of my goose. step aside or be pecked :)
oi {player}, it's {persona} of {my_faction} and i've been looking forward to this. the bridge at Lipnevo is watching, you know xD
ser {player}, {persona} of {my_faction} salutes you. mind the puddle, it has been following me all week :)
{player}!! {persona} of {my_faction} at your service, o noble wanderer. the goose sends its regards and one feather :D

whisper_taunt.text: {player}, i have been told you are scared of the bridge at Lipnevo. i have decided to be scared of it on your behalf :D
{rival} lost to me twice and {player} still thinks they are better? brave, very brave :)
hey {player}, {rival} said your cavalry smells like wet socks. i did not correct them, out of respect for the socks :P
{player}!! your sword is a fine stick. my goose has already started a fan club for {rival} out of pity xD
sir soggy boots sends regards to {rival}, and so do i, and so does the bridge. we are a united front !!
